name: Wave-scheduled iterative img2img loops (image and video)
plain: Workflow loops built on core common_ksampler rather than a new solver. ImageIterativeSampler feeds its output back as the next input for many iterations: each iteration optionally adds noise (a VAE-encoded noise image, or Gaussian), samples from start_at_step to an end step that grows by one per iteration within a cycle, and applies a per-iteration exponential zoom; each cycle restarts from the last result with seed+1000·cycle. VideoIterativeSampler does one img2img pass per input frame, with end step, zoom and style/CLIP strength following a triangle, sine, sawtooth or square wave over a cycle, and an optional 10% blend with the previous output frame. Style model, IPAdapter and ControlNet strengths can be wave-modulated too.
math:
Symbols: z latent; j iteration within cycle; w(p) wave value at position p.
Image: z ← z + a·n (n = VAE(noise image) or N(0,I)); end = start + step_floor + j; z ← KSamplerAdvanced(z, steps=end, start=start); zoom r^{j+1}.
Video frame f: end_f = round(w(f mod L) between start+floor and end_at); z_f ← 0.9 z_f + 0.1 z_{f−1} (feedback); z_f ← KSamplerAdvanced(z_f, steps=end_f, start=start).

props.extra_model_calls: one full partial sampling per iteration or frame
props.params: wave_config from WaveController, seed, add_noise, noise_injection_strength 0.1, lock_injection_seed, feedback_mode none|previous_frame, sampler_name, scheduler, cfg
